Synopsis:
    US equity futures are declining as Middle East hostilities (US-Iran war, Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure, Israeli strikes in Lebanon) push Brent crude to ~$99/bbl, its highest since late July. Markets are also navigating a complex macro environment: elevated Treasury yields (~4.80%), upcoming US CPI/PPI prints, and a ~61% market-implied probability of a Fed rate hike. Energy stocks outperform while crypto and broader equities retreat. The central tension is whether rising oil prices will complicate the Fed's inflation trajectory.
